description: The project involves literature survey, problem identification, problem formulation, solution finding, simulation or hardware implementation, and documentation. Students are assigned to a faculty advisor for project identification and allotment. Progress is monitored continuously by the faculty supervisor throughout the semester and the outcomes are evaluated on the basis of a presentation cum viva-voce examination and the report submitted.
outcomes: Carry out a literature survey of a particular topic related to an electrical system.
Identify recent problems and constraints faced by the research community.
Investigate a solution to minimize or mitigate the existing problem.
Validate the proposed solution with the help of a simulation or hardware setup.
